name: CacheLynx Product Cache Clearer for WooCommerce
author: Ming's IT Services Ltd.

sections.description:
Caching helps WooCommerce stores load faster and improves overall website performance. However, when a product is updated—especially a variable product—the cache may continue displaying outdated prices, stock quantities, and other product data. This can happen whether products are updated manually or imported from CSV or Excel files, potentially showing incorrect information to customers.

This plugin is designed to automatically clear WooCommerce product cache whenever a product is updated. It is particularly effective at removing variation-level cache for variable products, ensuring that updated prices, stock levels, and other variation data are displayed correctly. It also works seamlessly with simple products.

Once activated, no configuration is required. The plugin automatically detects product updates and clears the relevant cache, whether the changes are made manually in the WooCommerce admin area or through CSV/Excel imports. This ensures that your customers always see the latest product information.

Features

Automatically clear WooCommerce product cache whenever a variable or simple product is updated, either manually or by importing a csv/Excel file.
